## 0.1.0-beta.20

- Media art screensaver (supporter extra): titles are now picked evenly across all your movie and TV libraries, so a small library no longer repeats its few titles, and titles shown lately are skipped.
- The dimming row in Options is now "Menu dim after", or "Screensaver dim after" when a screensaver is on, so it says what it counts from. Paused video still dims after 3 minutes.
